name: Hitozuma Netori-ya
source:
The protagonist, after entering university and starting to live alone, decides to apply for a part-time job at the marriage consultation office "Learge".

However, behind the scenes, it's a company that fulfils divorce requests from discontent husbands. The jobs are accomplished by manufacturing adulteries with the wives and recording the acts as evidences. And somehow, the protagonist is chosen as one of the perpetrators.

[Translated from [url=http://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/hitozuma_ntr/story]Offcial Site[/url]]

When the game starts, you can select to disable or enable the Netorare point of view. If disabled, you won't see the scenes from other characters point of view, only half of the scenes will be seen.
